map.水加多会怎样？: What happens if too much water is added?
map.水灰比增大强度下降、易开裂离析；现场为方便浇筑乱加水是常见质量隐患，应严格控水。: A higher water-cement ratio lowers strength and promotes cracking and segregation; adding water on site just to make placing easier is a common quality hazard, so water must be strictly controlled.

map.现场调整坍落度时，用本工具理解水灰比对强度的影响方向，避免乱加水。: When adjusting slump on site, use this tool to understand which way the water-cement ratio moves strength, so that water is not added indiscriminately.
